●0000000005●

○0000000006○That day.
●0000000006●

○0000000007○Without a doubt, Lucia was the 'Key'.
●0000000007●

○0000000008○In that case... Who exactly was this girl who was the real 'Key'?
●0000000008●

○0000000009○Lucia, the "Key" who took the lives of over 200,000 people, is still struggling with the weight of what happened.
●0000000009●

○0000000010○If the world was destroyed, those 200,000 lives would be nothing compared to the billions of lives that would be lost.
●0000000010●

○0000000011○Will the real 'Key' with the resolve to take on the enormity of that decision really come to this world,
●0000000011●

○0000000012○I wonder?
●0000000012●

○0000000014○...I don't know.
●0000000014●

○0000000015○The only thing that can be said... The 'Key' will eventually reappear once more, somewhere on Earth.
●0000000015●

○0000000016○And a tragic decision will be made... To determine whether or not this world is meant to exist,
●0000000016●

○0000000017○and shoulder the responsibility for that decision.
●0000000017●

○0000000019○Will we, the human race, still be qualified to lead the world a thousand years from now?
●0000000019●

○0000000020○Lucia is the sin of humanity, created to reach that world of the future.
●0000000020●

○0000000021○It is far too cruel to ask her to carry that cross alone.
●0000000021●

○0000000022○Thus, I can't help but feel sorry for that "Key" who must bear this responsibility.
●0000000022●

○0000000023○That is why I will continue to pray... That there will be a world where the 'Key' will appear again
●0000000023●

○0000000024○and not have to make that decision.
●0000000024●

○0000000026○                               from the South America Diocese, No. 7 shelter, Girasol-7
●0000000026●

○0000000027○　　　　　　　　　　　　　　   　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　November 20, 2011 Tennouji Kotarou
